visual_logic.color_palette: Steel-blue with striking white 'eye-spots' distributed evenly along the extended horizontal neck; pearlescent clay texture.
visual_logic.action: Cruising levelly across the frame, fully extending its hyper-elongated neck anatomy.
visual_logic.environment: Deep indigo water with sharp, prismatic god-rays filtering vertically down from the surface, creating an elegant backdrop that does not disrupt the long silhouette.

pose: A strict side-profile view specifically designed to account for the animal's extreme long-necked proportions. The coiled neck and vertical descent are fully unrolled into a straight, level horizontal line swimming from left to right parallel to the frame edge. This allows the exceptionally long neck, compact body, and tail to map cleanly and end-to-end against the UI's tracking measuring tape layout.
